AST outside the fixture-format changes is identical to HEAD: public case iteration, four-arm manifest consumption, retry configuration, compact replication conditions, A2/A3 qualification and plan construction remain. LocalDriver still records real skill input/use/result via production helpers; no cached checker or mocked loader is introduced. Executed scenario and cold-replay equivalence remain unverified here.
